name: melee_parry_carriers_e75
note: Melee charge as melee_plain, but 3 of the 8 defenders carry a Parry(1) weapon and the attackers strike 8 times each, so the defender dies in every seed (no strike-back, no morale roll: the strike-back of a partly armed unit has its own scenario, melee_strike_back_bearers_e75). From epoch 75 the core rolls 3 Parry dice (carriers), not 8 (every model), like the table (#2642, #2662).
